title: Student groups protest outside IIT Bombay over student death
seoTitle: Mumbai IIT protest over student death

tea.why: Demanding justice and an independent probe into the death of a 19-year-old student who allegedly died by suicide.
tea.want: Independent investigation, resignation of the institute director, and accountability for institutional caste discrimination.
tea.changed: Oct 14: Around 25 to 30 protesters were detained outside IIT Bombay and later released following a delegation meeting.

summary: Student groups, Ambedkarite organisations, and activists staged a 'Chalo IIT' protest outside IIT Bombay's main gate in Mumbai on Wednesday, October 14, demanding an independent investigation into the death of a 19-year-old student and accountability from the administration. The agitation was held in solidarity with the student's parents, who have been on a 12-day hunger strike. Protesters also demanded the resignation of the institute's director, alleging procedural violations and institutional caste discrimination. A delegation of representatives met with the director and submitted a letter detailing their concerns. According to police, around 25 to 30 people were detained during the demonstration and subsequently released after the delegation meeting.
demands: Independent investigation into the student's death
response: According to DCP (West Zone III) Datta Nalawade, around 25 to 30 people were detained and later released after a six-member delegation met with IIT Bombay Director Shireesh Kedare. Protesters alleged that police used force during the detentions.
